distribution.summary: 河北；山东；湖南；四川；福建；云南；台湾；香港
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) supports occurrence in 河北、山东、湖南、四川、福建和云南. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds a first Taiwan record based on more than 150 specimens from Changhua, Chiayi, Kinmen, Nantou, Pingtung, Taichung, Taipei and Taoyuan. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) provides 17 explicit host taxa. Beaver & Liu (2010) states that Hypothenemus eruditus uses twigs, branches, seeds and fruits of hundreds of species. This broad host statement is retained as ecological context and is not expanded into inferred taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus eruditus (Westwood, 1834).

taxonomic_history.name: Hypothenemus eruditus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus eruditus (Westwood, 1834), VSN_3223, Scolytinae: Trypophloeini. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) both preserve authorship Westwood at source level. A previous profile record gave authorship Wollaston, 1854 was inconsistent with integrated taxonomic backbone and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
